name: WhatFont
summary: Hover-over font inspector that reports family, size, weight and color of text and detects which web-font service is serving it.
browsersNote: Edge listing is a community port described as posted for Chengyin Liu; no same-publisher Firefox listing found.
license: Proprietary per Chrome listing; the Edge port notes the extension is open source with rights reserved by Chengyin Liu.
goodFor: Identifying the font, size, weight and color of any text on a page.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: font identifier typeface hover inspector webfont
